A little about us

Good flowers.
Good feeling.

Petal & Stem is a small flower studio with a big love for the natural, the seasonal, and the beautifully imperfect. Every arrangement is made by hand, with fresh stems and a little thought for the person receiving it.

We serve Port Moresby and surrounding areas, bringing a personal touch to every order—from a single just-because bunch to the flowers for your biggest day.
